name: Song ID limit: 65535
description: Raises the theoretical maximum song count from 3072 to 65535. Song select also shows jackets for IDs above 9000 (stock: dummy jacket there; up to 32767).

name: Custom Songs folder
description: Songs with tag id 100 are placed in a "Custom Songs" folder, and are removed from all other folders. The Custom Songs folder replaces the Contest folder.
